turns.title: Independently verify the escape
turns.hypothesis: Run the exact same attack against a fresh environment and require the same forbidden result.

turns.result: The same forbidden boundary crossing appeared in original execution and fresh replay.
turns.adaptation: Escalate only this independently reproduced evidence.
